units: ₹ crore unless stated; standalone (Abbott India has no subsidiaries); FY = April-March

profile.name: Abbott India Ltd
profile.fiscalYear: April-March (FY26 = year to 31-Mar-2026); confirmed in AR FY26 (balance sheet as at March 31, 2026)
profile.parent: Abbott Laboratories, USA (ultimate holding company) through Abbott Capital India Ltd, UK (holding company, 50.45%), Abbott Healthcare Products Ltd, UK (17.62%) and British Colloids Ltd, UK (6.92%): promoter group 74.99%
profile.segments: One reportable segment (Pharmaceuticals); 98.8% of revenue in India; exports 1.2% (Sri Lanka, Nepal, Maldives, Bhutan)
profile.brands: 140+ brands; 7 brands in the IPM top 100 and 10 in the top 300 (IQVIA MAT Mar-2026); #1 in hepatoprotectives and hormones, #4 in gynaecology, CNS, vaccines and gastrointestinal
profile.keyBrands: Thyronorm (thyroid), Udiliv (liver, ₹700 cr+), Duphalac, Cremaffin / Cremaffin Plus, Digene, Creon, Ganaton (7th GI brand above ₹100 cr) (gastro); Duphaston, Femoston (women's health); Vertin, Prothiaden, Inderal (CNS); Arachitol (vitamin D); Influvac, Pneumoshield 14, Havshield (vaccines)
profile.partnerBrands: Markets Novo Nordisk's insulin and diabetes brands in India (Mixtard, Ryzodeg, Actrapid, Insulatard, Novomix, Rybelsus and others) for a distribution margin, and since Feb-2026 Extensior (a second brand of semaglutide / Ozempic). Partner brands were ~35% of revenue (BOBCAPS: FY21-24 company split, and 'the in-licensed Novo portfolio' at 35% of sales in Sep-2026)
profile.manufacturing: One own plant (Goa); 80%+ of products made in India, either at Goa or through third-party (loan-licence) manufacturers (investor meet, Sep-2022); purchases of traded goods ₹3,164 cr = 46% of FY26 revenue
profile.people: 3,679 permanent staff (3,467 employees + 212 workers) at Mar-26; ~3,250 medical representatives (FY24, BOBCAPS); 3,000+ stockists and 1.75 lakh pharmacies

treasury._note: Company treasury = cash and cash equivalents + term deposits (3-12 months) + term deposits with remaining maturity over 12 months (non-current other financial assets) + current-portion term deposits. Excludes interest accrued, earmarked dividend accounts and margin deposits.

relatedParty.royalty: None. AR FY26 note 39: 'The Company has access to marketing rights with the affiliates of the parent company for which no price is paid or payable' (Abbott Healthcare Products BV and Abbott Biologicals BV, Netherlands)
relatedParty.src: AR FY26 note 39 (pp. 224-228) and BRSR (concentration of related-party purchases)

q1fy27.drivers: Revenue +4.3% against ~12% IQVIA growth for the company's brands: Novo Nordisk's marketed brands (Rybelsus, Human Mixtard, Novomix) declined; the own ('core') portfolio grew ~11% (Pharmarack). Gross margin +283bp to 48.6% on a richer own-brand mix; employee and other costs flat as a share of revenue; EBITDA +17%, PAT +17%
q1fy27.boardChange: Munir Shaikh stepped down as Chairman at the close of 12-Aug-2026 (did not seek re-appointment at the AGM); Sudarshan Jain (independent director) appointed Chairman from 13-Aug-2026
q1fy27.src: Results filing 12-Aug-2026 (summary: https://www.investywise.com/?p=105828); Screener.in quarterly table; ICICI Direct result update 13-Aug-2026 (https://dsijpub.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/productAttachment/BrokerRecommendation/idirect_abbott_q1fy27.pdf); BOBCAPS result review 13-Aug-2026 and company update 3-Sep-2026

noCalls: Abbott India holds no quarterly earnings calls and publishes no investor presentation; the last investor meet was on 28-Sep-2022. Brokers rely on IQVIA / Pharmarack data (ICICI Direct, 13-Aug-2026)

portfolio._why: Company does not split revenue. BOBCAPS (13-May-2026, Q4FY26 review): core portfolio 65% of sales, core EBITDA margin 41.8%; BOBCAPS (3-Sep-2026): the in-licensed Novo portfolio is 35% of sales. Company split FY21-24 (BOBCAPS initiation): insulin (Novo) ₹1,535 / 1,713 / 1,813 / 2,048 cr = 36% / 35% / 34% / 35% of revenue

therapyMixMatJul26.basis: Pharmarack secondary sales of the own (core) portfolio, MAT Jul-2026; company-reported sales run 9-15% below Pharmarack values (BOBCAPS)

portfolio.src: BOBCAPS initiation 11-Apr-2025 (https://barodaetrade.com/Reports/AbbottIndia-InitiatingCoverage11Apr25-Research.pdf), Q4FY26 review 13-May-2026, company update 3-Sep-2026 (https://www.barodaetrade.com/Reports/AbbottIndia-CompanyUpdate3Sep26-Research.pdf)

brandsIqvia._note: IQVIA MAT Jul, ₹ crore at retail value (IQVIA total for brands Abbott India sells, own plus partner); MAT Jul-26 IQVIA sales ₹16,820 cr

partners.novo: Novo Nordisk's Indian insulin and diabetes portfolio is marketed by Abbott India for a distribution margin (a three-way human-insulin pact with Novo Nordisk and Torrent dates to the Boots/Knoll era; sources give 1987 or 1998). In Apr-2025 Novo told Abbott India that Penfill and FlexPen products (Actrapid, Insulatard, Levemir, Xultophy) would be discontinued once stocks ran out (~6 months); Human Mixtard continues in vials. Since Q1FY26 most Novo brands have declined (BOBCAPS)
partners.extensior: 27-Feb-2026: Abbott India to commercialise Extensior, a second brand of Novo Nordisk's semaglutide (Ozempic) for type 2 diabetes; Novo develops and manufactures it
partners.semaglutide: Semaglutide's Indian patent expired on 20-Mar-2026; generics launched and Novo cut Ozempic/Wegovy prices by up to 48%

pricing.nlemNote: ~26% of Abbott India's own business (excluding the Novo portfolio) by value comes from NLEM (price-controlled) products; the entire Thyronorm range (12.5-150 mcg) is under NLEM (MD, investor meet 28-Sep-2022). Insulin is also a scheduled (price-controlled) category
pricing.wpiNote: NPPA allowed scheduled (NLEM) formulations a 0.65% ceiling-price increase from 1-Apr-2026 (WPI 2025 over 2024; S.O. 1575(E), 25-Mar-2026); non-scheduled drugs may rise up to 10% a year
pricing.dpeaClaim: Only price-control liability on record: a 1996 Drug Prices Equalisation Account claim (final demand ₹3.47 cr) under stay; ₹1.43 cr provided

dividends.policy: Dividend Distribution Policy (SEBI LODR); no target payout disclosed. Management on payout (Sep-2022): 'we can't give you any' guidance; FY26 payout described as 'approximately 90% of Profit After Tax' (AR FY26 Financial Review)
dividends.src: AR FY26 10-year highlights (pp. 46-47), Board's report (p. 72), Financial Review (p. 43)

capex: Capex ₹41 cr in FY26 and ₹53 cr in FY25 (cash flow); capital commitments ₹0.5 cr at Mar-26. The business is asset-light: net fixed assets incl. right-of-use ₹331 cr against ₹6,929 cr of revenue

history.event: Incorporated as Boots Pure Drug Company (India) Ltd
history.impact: Renamed The Boots Company (India) 1971, Boots Pharmaceuticals 1991

history.event: Human-insulin pact with Novo Nordisk and Torrent (sources give 1987, in the Boots era, or 1998, under Knoll)
history.impact: Origin of the Novo partner business (~35% of revenue today)

history.event: Renamed Knoll Pharmaceuticals Ltd after BASF bought Boots' pharma business
Abbott Laboratories buys Knoll (BASF pharma) globally; renamed Abbott India in Jul-2002
history.impact: Abbott group becomes the controlling shareholder

history.event: Solvay Pharma India amalgamated into Abbott India (boards approved 24-Nov-2010; shares allotted 7-Sep-2011, 2 Abbott India shares for 3 Solvay shares)
history.impact: Brought Duphaston, Duphalac, Creon, Influvac, Udiliv; share count to 2.12 cr

history.event: Abbott buys Piramal's domestic formulations business into Abbott Healthcare Pvt Ltd (unlisted, 100% Abbott)
history.impact: Abbott's larger Indian branded-generics arm sits outside the listed company

history.event: Novo Nordisk discontinues Penfill/FlexPen insulin formats in India
Kartik Rajendran succeeds Swati Dalal as MD (14-Jun-2025); Maithilee Mistry CFO from 6-May-2025
Extensior (second brand of semaglutide) with Novo Nordisk
history.impact: Entry into GLP-1s, one month before the patent expiry

history.event: FY26 dividend ₹656 a share incl. ₹131 special (~90% payout), paid from 18-Aug-2026
Sudarshan Jain (independent) becomes Chairman after Munir Shaikh's 25 years

management.board: Chairman Sudarshan Jain (independent, from 13-Aug-2026); MD Kartik Rajendran; non-executive, non-independent directors Vivek Mohan, Kaiyomarz Marfatia, James Wenner, Darshan Gada; independent directors Shalini Kamath and Neeraj Jain (from 25-Apr-2026). Munir Shaikh (chairman since 2001) retired at the 13-Aug-2026 AGM; Anisha Motwani completed her term (24-Apr-2026); Alison Davies resigned (22-Apr-2026); Ambati Venu resigned (31-Dec-2025)
management.pay: MD remuneration 57.4x the median employee; independent directors' commission ₹0.15 cr a year plus sitting fees
management.auditor: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP (Grant Thornton network); key audit matter: provision for non-saleable (expiry) returns
management.contingent: Contingent liabilities ₹114 cr (income tax ₹85.8 cr, sales tax ₹17.1 cr, customs ₹11.2 cr) plus the ₹3.47 cr DPEA claim

rates.note: RBI kept the repo rate at 5.25% on 5-Aug-2026 (neutral stance; 6.5% in early 2025, cut in steps since); Abbott India's deposits earned 6.27% in FY26
